summary: Dashboard leave calendar (month view, scoped by role)
description: Month calendar on the dashboard from Figma frames 14:8878 and 14:9401. New scoped month query (employee: own; manager: own plus direct reports via users.manager_id; HR: everyone), pure layout helpers (month grid, week segments, lanes), previous/next/Today as links with ?month=YYYY-MM, a rejected toggle with ?rejected=1, a legend, and a text list for screen readers. APP_TIMEZONE (optional, default UTC) decides today. Bars have no link until the request detail page exists. Out of scope: an HR employee filter, a '+N more' cap, upcoming leave, recent activity.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: an employee sees only their own requests as spans, coloured by type, approved solid and pending striped;AC2: a manager sees own plus direct reports only and another team's request (Leo) never appears;AC3: HR sees every employee's requests;AC4: rejected requests are hidden unless the toggle is on;AC5: previous, next and Today change the month and today is highlighted;AC6: usable at 375px and 320px without horizontal scroll and every request is also available as text
